meta.purpose: Scholarship and means-tested bursary planning for tracked senior schools. Verify official pages before applying because criteria and deadlines can change.
meta.provenance: Official school sources unless a record explicitly says otherwise.

music.publishedStandard: No single grade threshold is stated on the general scholarship page; use the scholarship form and Director of Music guidance.
music.selection: Scholarship application plus the school's admissions process; current forms are published on the scholarship page.
music.note: Ask specifically how orchestral-instrument need and potential are weighted.

bursary.value: Awards can cover 50%–100% of fees; additional proportional help can include coach travel, lunches, educational trips and one instrument's music lessons.

music.publishedStandard: Around Grade 3 on two different orchestral instruments/voice, or a higher standard if offering only one.
music.selection: Application and reference; selected candidates audition/interview with the Director of Music in January, performing one piece on each instrument (or two contrasting pieces on one), plus sight-reading, aural and interview.
music.note: The current brochure explicitly says awards consider both ability and potential and expects substantial involvement in ensembles, orchestras, choirs or bands.

scholarships.deadlineLabel: Current brochure says indicate scholarship interest on registration; confirm the current application/reference deadline with Admissions.

bursary.deadlineLabel: Financial assistance should be declared on registration; contact the school before formally registering if support is essential.
bursary.value: Limited means-tested awards; assessed by an independent third party and reviewed annually.

music.publishedStandard: Approximately Grade 4 on the first-study instrument; a second study and/or voice is often offered but is not required.
music.selection: Two contrasting first-study pieces, optional second-study piece, sight-reading, aural tests and discussion of theory/musical interests.
music.note: Belmont awards run through Years 7–8; pupils can re-apply for Mill Hill awards at 13+.

scholarships.deadlineLabel: Published deadline for Creative and Sport applications for September 2027 entry; check whether Music follows the creative deadline on the current admissions calendar.

bursary.deadlineLabel: Contact the Foundation bursary team for the 2027–28 timeline.
bursary.value: May provide up to 100% of tuition fees. At Belmont, bursaries are awarded to outstanding pupils who have also received a scholarship.

music.publishedStandard: No grade threshold is stated on the current general scholarship page.
music.selection: Separate application; candidates meet the Head of Department and complete an assessment. Music assessment is scheduled in the January scholarship week.
music.note: Academic scholarships require no separate form; 11+/13+ candidates are considered through the entrance process.

scholarships.deadlineLabel: Music, Drama, Sport, STEAM and Art applications due by 4pm

bursary.value: Means-tested support for local families who could not otherwise afford fees.

schools.name: St Paul's School / St Paul's Prep

music.publishedStandard: At 11+, applicants are encouraged when working above Grade 5 on first study (Grade 6+ for piano) with a similar standard on a second instrument. At 13+, candidates are normally around Grade 6+ but the school stresses potential and notes instrument-specific differences.
music.selection: Performance plus musical assessments appropriate to entry point; 13+ includes quick study, aural tests, a short written paper and interview.
music.note: Scholarships are honorary with free tuition on two instruments; exhibitions provide free tuition on one.

scholarships.deadlineLabel: 13+ music entries normally close in mid-January; verify the cycle-specific date.

bursary.deadlineLabel: Apply through the admissions process and cycle-specific bursary timetable.
bursary.value: Founder's Awards can cover fees and a matching proportion of extras including uniform, trips, transport and music lessons/instrument loan.

music.publishedStandard: Contact the Head of Music for suitability; the public scholarship overview does not state a single grade threshold.
music.selection: Subject-head approval is required before scholarship registration.

scholarships.deadlineLabel: Scholarship dates are published in the school's 2026/27 scholarship timetable; eligibility/approval should be discussed with the relevant Head of Subject.

bursary.deadlineLabel: Follow the 13+ admissions and financial-assistance timetable.
bursary.value: Means-tested bursary support is available; verify the current award scale and deadlines with Admissions.
